findings.title: Frozen bootstrap candidate, evidence, and independent-review projection are not durably enforced
findings.reproduction: A nonexistent bootstrap implementation commit, zeroed evidence hash, APPROVED bootstrap status, and null review validate with no semantic errors. The review transition does not revalidate the packet, and no governed descendant-candidate resubmission exists.
findings.requiredRemediation: Use one bootstrap-packet validator from semantic validation, review, materialize, and activate; enforce review/status coherence; and add append-only descendant-candidate resubmission that preserves prior dispositions.

findings.title: Materialized amendment task definitions can drift from the immutable ECR packet
findings.reproduction: After materialization and activation, changing T01 objective and acceptance criteria while retaining its stored packet hash produces no semantic validation error.
findings.requiredRemediation: At every authority validation, compare task order and immutable fields with the approved packet and deny post-activation drift in validate, claim, evidence, review, and adoption paths.

findings.title: Lifecycle, campaign, Wave hold, and active-amendment state lack cross-field invariants
findings.reproduction: An ACTIVE amendment campaign combined with lifecycle APPROVED, ordinary Wave scope, and a null active_amendment marker validates with no errors; the pre-B00 schema also accepts the resulting ledger.
findings.requiredRemediation: Enforce a finite-state consistency table, exact active marker/campaign correspondence, approved bootstrap and exact tasks for executable states, Wave amendment-hold requirements, terminal restoration, and pre-B00-schema denial tests.

verification.evidenceTruth: The 45-file diff, ancestry, evidence hash, addendum hash, and stated checks were independently confirmed.
